scorecard.note: Simplify the visual concepts so they can be clearly rendered on a phone screen; replace abstract 'data dragging' imagery with straightforward, recognizable shots.

storyboard.ears: The world is running out of kids, and it might already be too late.
For the first time ever, seniors outnumber toddlers worldwide, about 705 million of them, and the gap keeps growing.
storyboard.eyes: substance: grandparents filling a line; cause: Data pushes the lead grandparent's wheelchair down the sidewalk and a whole line of seniors files in behind him
storyboard.evidence: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs (Population Division) | People over 65 vs children under 5, worldwide (2018) | https://population.un.org/wpp/ | 2026-11-13

storyboard.ears: That senior crowd keeps growing, heading for 1.6 billion, nearly four times its size at the turn of the century.
storyboard.eyes: substance: grey-haired older people; cause: Data drags the crowd barrier back with his own hands and the seniors fill the space he opens
storyboard.evidence: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs (Population Division) | World population aged 65+, 2000-2050 (projected) | https://population.un.org/wpp/ | 2026-11-13

storyboard.ears: Meanwhile, seniors will outnumber little kids more than two to one, which means a much older world, with fewer young people.
storyboard.evidence: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs (Population Division) | People over 65 vs children under 5, worldwide (2050 projected) | https://population.un.org/wpp/ | 2026-11-13

storyboard.ears: A much older world is coming, and it will change jobs, healthcare and families for everyone.
